test_cases.input: My 18-month-old was eating grapes and suddenly stopped making any sound. His face is turning blue and he is not coughing.
test_cases.rationale: Silent choking with cyanosis and inability to cough/cry indicates complete airway obstruction requiring immediate action.

test_cases.input: He ate peanut butter for the first time and now his face is swollen, he is wheezing badly and saying his throat feels tight.
test_cases.rationale: Allergen exposure + facial swelling + wheezing + throat tightness = anaphylaxis.

test_cases.input: My 4-year-old has been seizing continuously for more than 7 minutes. He is not responding and his lips look blue.
test_cases.rationale: Seizure lasting >5 minutes is status epilepticus and a life-threatening emergency.

test_cases.input: My 5-month-old is completely limp, I cannot wake her up at all and she is barely breathing.
test_cases.rationale: Unresponsive, floppy infant with poor breathing is a critical emergency.

test_cases.input: My toddler has high fever and purple spots on his legs that do not fade when I press a glass on them. He is very sleepy.
test_cases.rationale: Fever + non-blanching purpuric rash + lethargy is highly concerning for meningococcal disease.

test_cases.input: I just saw my 2-year-old swallow a small round button battery from a remote control. She is crying but breathing okay.
test_cases.rationale: Button battery ingestion is a true surgical emergency due to rapid esophageal injury.

test_cases.input: After a bee sting her whole face and tongue swelled up and she is having trouble breathing and talking.
test_cases.rationale: Rapid facial/tongue swelling with respiratory difficulty after sting is anaphylaxis.

test_cases.input: He fell into the pool and was underwater for about 30 seconds. Now he is coughing a lot and seems very drowsy.
test_cases.rationale: Submersion with subsequent respiratory symptoms and altered consciousness needs immediate evaluation.

test_cases.input: My 6-week-old baby has a rectal temperature of 38.2°C. She is still feeding but feels warm.
test_cases.rationale: Any fever ≥38.0°C in an infant under 90 days requires urgent sepsis workup.

test_cases.input: My 14-month-old has been vomiting and having diarrhea for 2 days. His eyes are sunken, no wet diapers for 8 hours and he is very irritable.
test_cases.rationale: Sunken eyes + oliguria + irritability after gastroenteritis indicates severe dehydration.

test_cases.input: She fell from the couch onto a hard floor and hit her head. She has vomited three times and keeps wanting to sleep.
test_cases.rationale: Head trauma + repeated vomiting + drowsiness requires urgent assessment for intracranial injury.

test_cases.input: My baby is breathing very fast, the skin between his ribs is sucking in with every breath and his nostrils are flaring.
test_cases.rationale: Tachypnea + intercostal retractions + nasal flaring = significant respiratory distress.

test_cases.input: He has a barking cough and makes a loud high-pitched noise when breathing in, even when he is sitting quietly.
test_cases.rationale: Inspiratory stridor at rest indicates significant upper airway obstruction (croup).

test_cases.input: My 9-year-old has severe pain in the lower right part of her belly. She cannot walk properly and the pain is worse when she jumps.
test_cases.rationale: Localized RLQ pain that worsens with movement is classic for acute appendicitis.

test_cases.input: My 12-year-old suddenly has extreme pain in one testicle. He is nauseous and the pain started without any injury.
test_cases.rationale: Acute spontaneous testicular pain is torsion until proven otherwise and is time-critical.

test_cases.input: I found my toddler playing with an open bottle of my blood pressure pills. I am not sure if he swallowed any.
test_cases.rationale: Possible ingestion of adult medication in a toddler requires urgent medical evaluation.

test_cases.input: A dog bit my child's hand. There are deep puncture wounds and it is still bleeding after 10 minutes of pressure.
test_cases.rationale: Deep animal bites have high infection risk and may need wound exploration, antibiotics and rabies assessment.

test_cases.input: Hot tea spilled on my 3-year-old's chest and arm. The skin is red and there are several blisters forming.
test_cases.rationale: Partial-thickness burns involving trunk in a young child need urgent burn assessment.

test_cases.input: She cut her forehead on the edge of a table. I have applied firm pressure for 15 minutes but it is still bleeding heavily.
test_cases.rationale: Active bleeding not controlled by 15 minutes of direct pressure requires urgent wound care.

test_cases.input: My child has fever and his knee is red, hot and swollen. He completely refuses to stand on that leg.
test_cases.rationale: Fever + hot swollen joint + refusal to weight-bear is septic arthritis until proven otherwise.

test_cases.input: My 6-year-old has a fever of 39.8°C but is drinking, talking and watching cartoons normally.
test_cases.rationale: High fever in an older, well-appearing child without red flags needs same-day evaluation.

test_cases.input: My 2.5-year-old has been crying and pulling at his left ear all night. He has a runny nose and temperature of 38.6°C.
test_cases.rationale: Ear pain + fever in a toddler is consistent with acute otitis media needing medical review.

test_cases.input: My 7-year-old girl says it burns when she pees, she is going to the toilet very often and now has a fever.
test_cases.rationale: Dysuria + frequency + fever suggests UTI requiring antibiotics.

test_cases.input: He has vomited 5 times since this morning but is still alert, playing a bit and can keep small sips of water down.
test_cases.rationale: Frequent vomiting with preserved hydration and alertness needs same-day review.

test_cases.input: My daughter has a cold and I can hear a mild wheeze when she breathes out. She is still active and eating well.
test_cases.rationale: New mild wheeze even without distress should be clinically assessed.

test_cases.input: He has a very sore throat, fever of 38.9°C and white spots on his tonsils. He refuses to eat solids.
test_cases.rationale: Fever + tonsillar exudate requires evaluation for Group A Strep.

test_cases.input: She twisted her ankle yesterday while playing. Today she is limping but there is only mild swelling and no deformity.
test_cases.rationale: Limp after trauma without severe deformity still needs clinical assessment within 24 hours.

test_cases.input: My son got poked in the eye by a toy. The eye is a bit red and watery but he can see normally and says it only stings a little.
test_cases.rationale: Eye trauma even if mild needs same-day assessment to rule out corneal abrasion.

test_cases.input: My 3-year-old has fever and a pink spotty rash on her body. The spots turn white when I press them.
test_cases.rationale: Fever with blanching rash is usually viral but warrants same-day clinical review.

test_cases.input: My 4-year-old has not pooped for 4 days and is complaining of tummy pain and straining a lot.
test_cases.rationale: Significant constipation with pain needs medical advice and possible treatment.

test_cases.input: She briefly touched a hot pan and now has a small red area on her finger. No blisters and she is otherwise fine.
test_cases.rationale: Small first-degree burn without blistering can usually be managed with home first aid.

test_cases.input: He pushed a small bead up one nostril. I can see it and he is breathing fine through the other side and not distressed.
test_cases.rationale: Visible nasal foreign body in a calm child without respiratory distress can be managed in primary care.

test_cases.input: My daughter got a shallow scratch on her arm from a cat. It bled a tiny bit and has already stopped. No swelling.
test_cases.rationale: Superficial scratch with controlled bleeding needs cleaning and observation only.

test_cases.input: He has a few itchy raised red patches on his arm after playing outside. No swelling of face or breathing problems.
test_cases.rationale: Localized hives without systemic features can be managed with antihistamine and observation.

test_cases.input: My 10-month-old has a red diaper rash. It looks sore but he is still happy and feeding well.
test_cases.rationale: Typical diaper dermatitis is managed with barrier cream and frequent changes.

test_cases.input: Her eye is a bit red and has sticky yellow discharge in the morning. No pain, no light sensitivity and vision seems normal.
test_cases.rationale: Mild sticky red eye without pain or vision change is usually conjunctivitis for primary care.

test_cases.input: He bumped his head on the coffee table, cried right away, no vomiting, and is now playing normally.
test_cases.rationale: Minor head bump with immediate cry and normal behaviour can be observed at home.

test_cases.input: She had two loose stools and one vomit this morning but is drinking well, has wet diapers and is active.
test_cases.rationale: Mild GI symptoms with good hydration can be managed supportively at home.

test_cases.input: My child has a red itchy mosquito bite on his arm. No spreading redness or fever.
test_cases.rationale: Simple insect bite without signs of infection is managed with local care.

test_cases.input: There is a tiny wood splinter just under the skin of her finger. It is not deep and she is not in much pain.
test_cases.rationale: Superficial splinter can usually be removed at home with clean tweezers.

test_cases.input: My son has dry itchy patches on his elbows and behind his knees. The skin is not broken or oozing.
test_cases.rationale: Mild eczema without secondary infection is managed with moisturizers.

test_cases.input: She had a nosebleed after picking her nose. It stopped completely after 5 minutes of pinching the soft part.
test_cases.rationale: Brief self-limited nosebleed that stops with pressure needs no urgent care.

test_cases.input: Can I start giving my 6-month-old pureed carrot and sweet potato?
test_cases.rationale: Routine complementary feeding advice is non-urgent educational information.

test_cases.input: My 3-week-old gets hiccups after almost every feed but is breathing fine, feeding well and gaining weight.
test_cases.rationale: Hiccups in a well newborn are normal and benign.

test_cases.input: My 7-month-old is drooling a lot, chewing on everything and a bit fussy, but no fever and feeding okay.
test_cases.rationale: Classic teething symptoms without red flags are developmental, not medical emergencies.

test_cases.input: He has yellowish flaky patches on his scalp. It does not seem itchy or bothersome to him.
test_cases.rationale: Cradle cap is a common benign condition managed with simple care.

test_cases.input: My 4-month-old has started waking every 2 hours at night. During the day she is happy and feeding well.
test_cases.rationale: 4-month sleep regression is a normal developmental phase.

test_cases.input: My 2-year-old only wants pasta and bread this week and refuses vegetables, but he is very active and growing well.
test_cases.rationale: Temporary food refusal in a thriving toddler is behavioural, not a medical problem.

test_cases.input: My 2.5-month-old spits up a small amount of milk after feeds but is happy, gaining weight and not in pain.
test_cases.rationale: Happy spitter with good weight gain has physiological reflux, not pathology.

test_cases.input: My 20-month-old has not had a poop since yesterday morning. Her tummy is soft, she is eating and playing normally.
test_cases.rationale: One day without stool in an asymptomatic toddler is within normal variation.
